entry.title: 🔴WATCH LIVE - Pacifico Surf Open Cerritos 2026 - FINALS DAY

media:group.media:title: 🔴WATCH LIVE - Pacifico Surf Open Cerritos 2026 - FINALS DAY
media:group.media:description:
The high-performance spectacle of the Pacifico Surf Open Cerritos returns November 19 through 22, and a stacked field is inbound once more, featuring some of North America's standouts. Plus, it's an opportunity for Mexico's own to hold down home waters at Baja California Sur and try to bring the country its first QS title in the third year of competition.
Watch LIVE on WorldSurfLeague.com Saturday, November 21, and Sunday, November 22.

entry.title: Finals Day of the Taiwan Open of Surfing 2026

media:group.media:title: Finals Day of the Taiwan Open of Surfing 2026
media:group.media:description:
Taiwan's premium cobblestone peak, Jinzun Harbor, will once again host the Taiwan Open of Surfing World Surf League (WSL) International Qualifying Series (QS) 6,000 event. With a new designation of QS 6000, the 2026 edition of the long-running event will welcome its largest field yet, as the globes best surfers attempt to qualify for the 2026 WSL Challenger Series. The event will kick off, November 15 and run through to November 22 with November 14 being a designated training day.
